subject: GDPR: DPA & SCC selection — follow-up from today's call
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: GDPR: DPA & SCC selection — follow-up from today's call

Hi Sarah — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our side:  

1) Controller/Processor alignment
- You confirmed Acme Health will act as Controller and Redwood Inference as Processor for the services discussed. Please confirm if there are any sub-processors you want listed or blocked; we currently expect AWS/GCP managed infra.

2) SCC module selection
- Based on the controller/processor relationship discussed, Module 2 (Controller-to-Processor) looks like the right fit. I attached our SCC mapping (scc-matrix-v2.xlsx) for your legal team to review.

3) DPA execution
- Draft DPA attached for review (redwood-DPA-draft-20260214.pdf). We can take edits in DocuSign; link will be provided once you confirm the version.

4) SOC 2 status and evidence
- Short answer: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type I in 2025; Type II audit is in progress with expected completion by 2026-04-15. I attached a short summary (SOC2-summary-2025.pdf). Rishi is copied and will follow up with the SOC2 timeline and any interim evidence we can share.

5) Vendor questionnaire
- If you want to kick off your VSQ now, please send the template; otherwise we can send our standard security package first.

Proposed next steps:
- You: confirm Controller role and SCC Module preference (reply ok)
- Us: share final DPA + DocuSign link once legal edits are agreed
- Schedule a 30-min security review (Rishi + your security contact) — I listed a few windows below.

Availability (PST): Mon 2/16 9:00–11:00, Tue 2/17 14:00–16:00, Wed 2/18 8:30–10:00. Let me know what works and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-DPA-draft-20260214.pdf], [Attachment: scc-matrix-v2.xlsx], [Attachment: SOC2-summary-2025.pdf]

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

From: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GDPR: DPA & SCC selection — follow-up from today's call

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from our side:

- Confirmed: Acme Health is Controller; Redwood Inference is Processor. We do expect any sub-processors to be called out.
- SCC: Our legal prefers Module 2 (Controller-to-Processor) for the DPA flow you outlined. We will review the scc-matrix and give feedback by EOD Tuesday.
- DPA: We have a few minor redlines (standard procurement language). I’ve attached our vendor security questionnaire (VSQ-Acme-2026.xlsx) — can you confirm who on your team will own responses?
- SOC2: We need the Type II report once available; interim artifacts are fine for procurement. Please share anything Rishi can surface.

Procurement timeline: We’re aiming to finish legal and security review by 3/5 so we can get purchasing approvals before quarter-end.

Proposed security contact for the 30-min review: Tom Rivera (cc'd) — he handles vendor security for Acme. Tom, can you propose 2 slots next week?

Thanks,
Sarah Thompson
Head of Procurement | Acme Health
sarah.thompson@acmehealth.com

Attachments: [Attachment: VSQ-Acme-2026.xlsx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GDPR: DPA & SCC selection — follow-up from today's call

Thanks Sarah — appreciate the timeline and the VSQ. Answers below and next actions:  

- Controller/Processor: confirmed in writing — Acme = Controller, Redwood = Processor. We will include standard sub-processor list in the DPA and can add any exclusions you require.

- SCC Module 2: agreed — we will use Module 2 language. Rishi, can you please attach the SCC addendum language to the DPA and confirm there are no conflicts with our standard terms?

- DPA redlines: please send the specific redline markups; Monica (cc'd) will consolidate legal comments and route internally. Once we have agreed redlines, I’ll initiate DocuSign.

- SOC2 evidence: attaching what we can share today (SOC2-summary-2025.pdf). Rishi: ETA for Type II completion and whether we can provide interim control mappings?

- VSQ: Rishi will own the VSQ response. Sarah, can you confirm whether you prefer XLS answers or a shared Google Sheet template?

Proposed meeting windows (converted to your timezone): Tue 2/17 17:00–17:30 CET (8:00–8:30 PST), Wed 2/18 11:00–11:30 CET (2:00–2:30 PST), Thu 2/19 09:00–09:30 CET. Hoping one of those works for Tom. If yes, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: [Attachment: SOC2-summary-2025.pdf] 

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GDPR: DPA & SCC selection — follow-up from today's call

Hi Sarah — looping in legal if needed, quick notes from security/controls perspective:

- SOC2 Type II: audit in progress; auditor on site March 2026; projected sign-off 2026-04-15. We can provide interim control mappings and selected evidence (access control screenshots, encryption at-rest config) under an NDA if that helps procurement.

- Encryption keys: By default keys are platform-managed; we do offer customer-managed keys for enterprise Private deployments. Is Acme planning to use our hosted offering or Private (VPC/on-prem)? If hosted, we can discuss KMS options and bring in solutions engineering.

- VSQ: I’ll start the XLS answers this week and share a draft link by EOD Friday. Sarah — if you prefer a shared Google Sheet, say the word and I’ll export our answers there.

Next steps: Marissa to collect DPA redlines; Monica to consolidate legal comments; I will prepare VSQ draft + interim SOC2 artifacts.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Compliance (acting) | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
